output.answer: Whirlpool Corporation’s latest quarterly filing, covering September 30, 2026, reports Whirlpool India as a 40%-owned equity-method investment rather than a controlled subsidiary; Whirlpool India and Elica PB India were deconsolidated in the fourth quarter of 2025. Its latest annual subsidiary schedule, dated December 31, 2025 and filed February 11, 2026, lists InSinkErator LLC, KitchenAid Global LLC, Maytag Sales, Inc., and Maytag Limited. International examples include Whirlpool Canada Co., Whirlpool Canada LP, Whirlpool S.A., Whirlpool do Brasil Ltda., Whirlpool Mexico, S. de R.L. de C.V., and Whirlpool Argentina S.r.l. The schedule also lists KitchenAid Australia, Pty Ltd, KitchenAid France SAS, KitchenAid Germany GmbH, and KitchenAid UK Limited. These are examples rather than the complete roster; the full published legal-entity list is in [Whirlpool’s Exhibit 21](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106640/000010664026000009/exb21listofsubsidiaries123.htm).
caveats: The subsidiary names above come from the December 31, 2025 annual schedule, not a complete legal-entity register updated to November 11, 2026; the September 2026 quarterly filing provides more recent ownership information.

This answer identifies legal subsidiary entities, rather than treating appliance brand names as interchangeable with subsidiaries, and gives a selection rather than reproducing every holding, financing and operating entity.

key_facts.fact: Whirlpool reported a 40% equity-method interest in Whirlpool India; it had deconsolidated Whirlpool India in the fourth quarter of 2025 after losing control.
Elica PB India, controlled by Whirlpool India, was also deconsolidated following completion of the Whirlpool India share sale.
Whirlpool filed its 2025 annual report, including Exhibit 21, List of Subsidiaries, for the period ended December 31, 2025.
Listed subsidiaries include InSinkErator LLC, KitchenAid Global LLC and Maytag Sales, Inc. in Delaware, and Maytag Limited in Ontario.
Listed Canadian entities include Whirlpool Canada Co. in Nova Scotia and Whirlpool Canada LP in Ontario.
Listed Latin American entities include Whirlpool S.A. and Whirlpool do Brasil Ltda. in Brazil; Whirlpool Mexico, S. de R.L. de C.V. in Mexico; and Whirlpool Argentina S.r.l. in Argentina.
Listed KitchenAid entities include KitchenAid Australia, Pty Ltd, KitchenAid France SAS, KitchenAid Germany GmbH and KitchenAid UK Limited.
